findings.claim: The active Discord and Slack consumers must load Deliberation through the separately packaged public API/test contract rather than the retired bundled implementation.
findings.observed: The task checkpoint leaves owner package acquisition and migration of all three loaders incomplete; the supplied handoff contains only the host contract, suite log, and retirement manifest, with no runnable public package contract or archive.
findings.rationale: Retiring the bundled implementation without a runnable config-origin package path leaves the active host consumers unable to load Deliberation and does not complete the required host decoupling.
findings.required: Supply the pinned repo-local offline public package/test contract and migrate all three consumers to config-origin package resolution while preserving their scenarios and assertions.

findings.claim: The retirement deliverable requires assertion-level external-owner mapping and immutable expanded proof for both transferred Slack root and child orchestration scenarios.
findings.observed: The supplied retirement checkpoint states that the manifest has no dynamic target titles or target assertions, and the follow-up checkpoint leaves acquisition of orchestration-assertion-map.json and expanded root/child evidence incomplete.
findings.rationale: Case-count parity and a broad suite receipt do not establish preservation of the required identity, bounded history, unrelated-thread exclusion, envelope and receipt, send-count, and lifecycle assertions.
findings.required: Supply the owner-exported assertion map and immutable expanded passing root/child evidence covering every required scenario invariant.

findings.claim: This caller-declared TDD task requires a complete ordered RED/GREEN proof for the acceptance repair.
findings.observed: The supplied proof projection contains only a RED phase and explicitly reports missing GREEN and incomplete phase order; the task checkpoint likewise leaves ordered GREEN capture incomplete.
findings.rationale: The manifest declares tddRequired true, and RED-only evidence does not demonstrate that the follow-up implementation reached GREEN.
findings.required: After completing the repair, capture and supply a fresh GREEN linked to the genuine RED with complete phase ordering and provenance.

goals.summary: [acceptance-fix] [acceptance-fix] Deliberation plugin: retire replaced bundled implementation and host path coupling: go
